provenance_claim_mappings.subject: Apossible Base Definition
provenance_claim_mappings.statement: Apossible is All things categorically attributable to any recursively ordered Possible levels of Metarules and All things categorically attributable to any recursively ordered Impossible levels of Metarules.

provenance_claim_mappings.subject: Toren Recurrence Relation
provenance_claim_mappings.statement: Toren n interleaves between odd Apossible orders: Apossible^(2n-1) < Toren n < Apossible^(2n+1) for n >= 1.

provenance_claim_mappings.subject: Supramajor Retroactive Acquisition
provenance_claim_mappings.statement: Supramajor describes an extent of majorness so great that it retroactively acquires new Bloodline Blessings whose quality has a Toren index directly proportional to its Supramajorness.

provenance_claim_mappings.subject: Archarthitean Factor Strength Scaling

provenance_claim_mappings.subject: Rhayhara Four Seal Factors
provenance_claim_mappings.statement: Four Seal Factors govern Rhayhara's memory-linked unsealing: Restored former strength, Restoration acceleration, Interseal metadifferential, and Negative-rewrite retroincrease.

provenance_claim_mappings.subject: PHK Stress-Amplified Feedback Loop
